description: Bluetooth device list with connect/disconnect, plus a per-device A2DP codec picker (LDAC, aptX HD, …) with LDAC quality control and automatic hi-res preference

barWidget.description: Bluetooth device list with connect/disconnect, plus a per-device A2DP codec picker (LDAC, aptX HD, …) with LDAC quality control and automatic hi-res preference

schema.label: Prefer hi-res codec on connect
schema.description: When a device connects, switch it to the best hi-res codec it offers (LDAC, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive, LC3plus HR) if PipeWire picked a lesser one.

schema.label: LDAC quality applied on connect
schema.description: auto = adaptive bitrate (PipeWire default); hq = 990/909 kbps; sq = 660/606 kbps; mq = 330/303 kbps. hq is true hi-res but may stutter on a crowded 2.4 GHz link.

schema.label: Show codec chips under connected devices
